note: MOD_PLAN.md section 6 item 39, LEADS.md Part I I6: STRATA_LOOKAHEAD_SKIP_DROPPED=1 (coded, lookahead_skip.hpp): with the miss-skip rule on (STRATA_MISS_SKIP_W / _CUM, spec 88 values, LOSSY by that rule), the look-ahead leaves unwarmed the predicted experts the rule would drop (predicted shares = softmax of the host router's top-k logits). The pair that isolates the switch is `preread-skipw05` vs `preread-skipw05-skipdropped` (and the cum90 pair); `preread` is the look-ahead without any skip. The switch changes only what is warmed, so the two arms of a pair emit the same text (drift_check / DIFFERENT would be a bug). Expected effect: small (fewer wasted warms); in our engine a warm does not make an expert GPU-resident, so the 'un-drop' mechanism of BigMoeOnEdge applies only with STRATA_FS_SLOTS. The log line 'strata lookahead: SKIP_DROPPED on' shows it acted, 'skip-dropped: N predicted entries left cold' (with STRATA_LOOKAHEAD_STATS=1) how often. Stop pancake.service first.
